description: TestMaker lets you create and manage your own study workbooks through ChatGPT. View your existing workbooks and questions, create new workbooks, and add, edit, or delete questions. Use it to organize study material for school tests, entrance exams, professional certifications, and language learning. A TestMaker account is required.

defaultPrompt: Create an exam-focused workbook from the attached document, covering its most important concepts.
Create a workbook for learning English vocabulary and add 10 questions with answers and explanations.
Add questions from the attached material to one of my existing workbooks without creating duplicates.
